escena: SCENE (cinematic still, a dark studio at night): a fan of a dozen premium finished campaign pieces — printed posters, magazine spreads, social posts on thin glass screens, packaging — spread out in a perfect half circle on a dark table and lit by a single dramatic overhead spotlight, each piece showing a different vivid, art-directed image in strong colour-block palettes (orange, magenta, azure, teal, lime); the pieces in the centre are sharp, the edges fall into shadow. It reads as a curated portfolio of real work. COMPOSITION FOR A CIRCULAR CROP: everything important stays inside the central circle of the square; the four corners are only dark empty space.  Rich contrast, punchy saturated colour, real photographic detail and texture (dust, micro-scratches, real depth of field), no text, no readable letters or numbers, no logos of any other brand.
